title: Capability Grants
description: Permission grants scoped to a single capability job. A grant is the most a capability may do; policy/approval already gated it upstream. Mirrors the Rust struct CapabilityGrants in crates/delta-core/src/capability/abi.rs.

read_roots.description: Absolute directories the capability may read (the workspace is always included).

write_roots.description: Absolute directories the capability may write (empty = read-only).

network.description: Allowed outbound network targets, e.g. https://api.example.com:443.

secrets.description: Secret grant keys the capability may read from the secrets boundary.

exec.description: Whether the job may spawn processes (shell/exec).

execution_epoch.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, fractional) marking when the grant becomes active. null = immediately.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds, fractional) marking when the grant expires. null = no expiry.
